scope: Read-only, reuse-first source-pixel review for replacing the weak shared Garden sprout and five live mature flower results. Search was limited to relevant existing flora named by prior Garden/Farmer/terrain/backlog evidence plus closely related Fairy and pool-flower runtime assets. No pixels, runtime bindings, protected originals, imports, or source files were modified. Scores are source role-fit judgments, not mounted runtime acceptance.

constraints: five mature results must remain visually distinct rather than repeat one or two plants
seed to sprout to mature progression must be semantically clear
plant bottoms must anchor convincingly in the existing Garden plots
direct files must remain readable within current 148x148 sprout and 228x228 mature draw boxes
reuse must preserve existing licensed files and avoid protected-original edits

duplicate_and_non_candidate_findings: assets/mg/sprout.png has SHA-256 d7542d8d812a28ddce435c8acf3a103df85e5af59178ad05c9bdb5fef1ed0926, identical to the already rejected live k_sprout pixels; it is not an improvement.
assets/mg/seed.png is a strong painted seed and remains a useful continuity anchor, but it is the existing seed state rather than one of the six requested replacement roles.
The coral and lavender terrain paths are exact byte duplicates of the two story paths, leaving only two distinct conventional mature plants.

The Fairy bud/opening/bloom cards are successive states of one magical purple plant. Counting them as three different mature flowers would violate distinct-role semantics even though each source is polished.
Protected book/friend images were not proposed because direct reuse would change character/story identity and protected originals may not be altered.

coverage_result.rationale: The inventory provides two polished rooted mature plants but no coordinated sprout and no third through fifth distinct mature plants. Combining unrelated Fairy boss phases, a pool float and opaque low-poly clusters would create a less coherent family and would not satisfy role, grounding, style or phone-readability requirements.

reuse_first_production_brief.gap: One coordinated painted sprout plus at least three additional mature rooted flowers are still missing if coral and lavender can be mounted successfully; otherwise all six replacement roles remain a coordinated-family gap.
do_not_force: Do not use duplicate terrain aliases to pretend there are four mature designs.
Do not assign Fairy bud/opening/bloom phases as separate mature species.
Do not use the hollow helpful gate, stemless pool float, or opaque QA clusters as Garden plants.
Do not crop, recolor, derive, or rewrite pixels under this direct-reuse review.
reuse_first_production_brief.required_next_evidence: Before accepting even coral or lavender, mount exact files non-destructively in representative 228x228 slots and capture each alone plus all-five composition under Mobile. Verify bottom/root contact, occupied size, no crowding, source hash, and consistency with the seed, sprout, watering action and neighboring plants. Animation and target-device review remain required.
